featureType.name: MaC_3-15_SRW_tracking_SSM_paths
featureType.title: Interpolated tracking movements of Southern right whales from SSM - paths (NESP MaC 3.16)
featureType.abstract:
Interpolated positions of four southern right whales satellite tagged in Encounter Bay, SA in June 2024. Locations are predicted at six-hour intervals using a state-space model, together with dive metrics summarised for the three hours before and after each modelled location.
This layer shows the paths between SSM-predicted points, and should be used for display in a layer group only (not for download).
